"Only limit wohi—jo tum khud set karte."
"Ya toh mehnat, ya phir afsos—dono me se."
"Success final nahi, failure fatal nahi."
"Hard cheez pe kaam se motivation aati."
Kuch naya karo.
Disappointment success ki tuition hai.
Seekhte raho.
Jitni mushkil jung, utni shandaar jeet.
"Greatness ek choice hai."
"Face sunshine ki taraf rakho—shadow piche girengi."
Believe karo tum kar sakte ho—aadha kaam ho gaya.
Self-belief self-control banati hai.
Mahaan kaam karne ka iklauta tareeqa hai ki aap jo karte hain usse pyaar karein.
Kal ko realize karne ki limit aaj ke doubts hain.
